market_summary: During the London session, all six tracked assets are consolidating inside their respective Value Areas with no confirmed breakout volume. FX pairs EURUSD and GBPUSD are compressed directly onto daily VWAP and POC levels in tight rangebound chop. US100 and precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) remain beneath downward-sloping VWAP and EMA50 lines but have paused near lower value boundaries, with US100 holding VAL support at 28159.85. BTCUSD is oscillating around session POC at 68676.09. Broad absence of RVOL > 2.0 expansion and lack of edge inside Value Areas require a disciplined HOLD across all symbols awaiting London/NY overlap liquidity.
